properties.title: Hazardous Operations
properties.body:
[Kattegat] DANISH NAV WARN 463/26
DENMARK. KATTEGAT. ØSTER FLAK SE.
ON 21 NOVEMBER FROM 0800 UTC TO 1200
UTC, A FIRING EXERCISE WILL BE HELD FROM
HDMS NYMFEN (DANISH WARSHIP P524), FROM
POS. 56-53.0N 011-05.0E
LIVE ORDNANCE WILL BE USED.
MILITARY GUARD VESSELS WILL BE PRESENT
AND CAN BE CONTACTED ON VHF CH 16 AND
06.
MARINERS ARE ADVISED TO KEEP A
SAFETY DISTANCE OF 5NM.
